div.h2: Eliminate Manual Tax Adjustments & Audit Vulnerabilities
div.p: Every accounting entry in Nova ERP automatically respects Ethiopian tax proclamations, labor law payroll rules, and fiscal calendar dates.

div.class: w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-blue-950 text-brand-interactive flex items-center justify-center mb-6

span.class: text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-blue-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-800

div.p: Payment wizard automatically separates 2% for goods transactions over 10,000 ETB and 3% for services over 3,000 ETB. Instantly prints official MoR Withholding Tax Certificates (wht.tax.receipt) at time of disbursement.

div.p: Full dual-calendar engine syncing Gregorian and Ge'ez (Julian) dates across sales, inventory, and financial statements. Automates fiscal year closing on Sene 30 with zero manual journal adjustments.

div.p: Generates standardized Ministry of Revenues electronic invoices with Base64 QR code encoding TIN, buyer TIN, invoice number, VAT amount, and cryptographic signature hash.

div.class: flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 mb-3

div.p: ZKTeco biometric integration, 7% employee pension, 11% employer contribution, severance logic, and annual leave Ge'ez calendar tracking.

div.p: Say goodbye to paper bank deposit slips and fraudulent screenshot receipts. Nova ERP connects directly with Ethio Telecom Telebirr and Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) APIs.
